notes.title: Elsewhere High: Chapters 1 AND 2 coming to Steam very soon.
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Elsewhere High got Greenlit back in November and I have yet to post an announcement. This is because, frankly, I have been so hard at work fine tuning this story and molding it into the product that I imagined it to be. I want nothing less than greatness for this story. 

What I realized is that while Chapter 1 is a great introduction into this novel, I wanted to launch it with a companion. I have been pushing the release of the debut chapter until it's successor is ready to launch along side of it. Today Chapter 2 has reached completion and it will only be a short while until they both launch simultaneously on Steam. 

As promised, Chapter 1 will be free and each subsequent chapter can be bought at a small fee (to be determined.) 

Some things to look forward to: 

Chapter 1 generally takes readers around 80 minutes to complete. 
It features scenes that allow the reader to choose how to respond to certain situations, who to spend time with, etc. 
There are 8 original, breathtaking pieces of background art. 

Chapter 2 takes closer to two hours to complete. 
There are a greater number of choices and the story is told through a much broader lens. 
More original artwork from the same incredibly talented artist. 
Two new characters are introduced. 

Elsewhere High is a kinetic novel. Each chapter follows the same narrative for each player, just with diversions along the way. 

I am so indescribably excited to share this work with you. I hope we can build a fun and inviting community around this project and share laughter, tears, and the odd spook together. 

Coming soon. 

- The EH Team.
